title: Design Patterns & SOLID
intro: Design-pattern interviews test whether you can apply a pattern to a real problem, not just name it. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with SOLID (the design-principle foundation), then the three GoF categories — creational, structural, behavioral — in order of how often they're asked. From there it moves to refactoring and technical debt (the applied tier: when patterns meet legacy code), then the legacy-patterns and comparison canon. It closes with scenario-based questions where you choose the right pattern for a stated problem.
